title: Sakina aur zahra
body:
sakina aur zahra ki musibat ek jaisi hai
hai tooti phasliyan dono ki halat ek jaisi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wahan binte rasollallah ka pehlu sikasta hai
yahan bacchi ke kaano se abhi bi khoon rista hai
lehad mein jaa ke bhi dono ki ghurbat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wahan kunfuz ke haathon ne koi tehreer likhi hai
yahan tahreer zaalim shimr ke haathon ki milti hai
likhi dono ke chehron par ibaarat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
gayi ek ek dar par fatema shehr e madina mein
sakina dar badar phirti rahi hai shaam o kufa mein
wilayat ke liye inki musaafat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e darbar daadi aur pothi ki hui peshi
wo athara baras ki aur ye hai chaar barson ki
na jaane phir bhi kyon baalon ki rangat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
usay kehte thay yasrab waale roye shehr se bahar
tamache maarte thay shaam waale is ko rone par
dilon mein baap ko rone ki hasrat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgar ke tamache ki na jaane kaisi zarbat hai
sahare se chale deewar ke dono qayamat hai
nazar kuch bhi nahi aata basaarat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay se murtaza ke rassiyan zahra chudati hai
sakina tauq pe sajjad ke pani bahaati hai
imamat ke liye dono ki mehnat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mita dena nishane qabre mayyat qabr mein rakh kar
wilayat ka koi munkir nahi aaye janaze par
imam e waqt se unki wasiyat ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat ban ke aaya tha takallum waqt magrib ka
idhr bali sakina ka udhar zahra ka dam nikla
jahan se inke jaane ki bhi saa'at ek jaisi hai
sakina aur zahra ki...
author: Mir Takallum
